prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Check your desktop system tray icon to hide, show, or customize your companion anytime.", "Desktop Tray Controls Active"]
1: ["Upload Clear Photos of Your Companion", "Use bright lighting and clear front angles for best 3D pet generation results.", "Select Pet Photos"]
2: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose how you want to bring your digital companion to life on your desktop screen."]
3: ["Log in with your existing account to restore all previously saved pets and progress.", "Account Pet Recovery Active"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space", "Your companion is getting ready to spawn on your desktop screen.", "Finalizing desktop integration and assets..."]
5: ["Name Your Desktop Companion", "Give your new pet a name that will appear on its official adoption certificate.", "Pet Name", "Confirm & Finalize Certificate", "Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially ready to move onto your desktop."]
6: ["Your companion is now active! If you do not see it immediately, check your system tray or minimize active windows.", "Right-click the tray icon if your pet is hidden behind active application windows."]
7: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to create a completely custom pet.", "Pre-made pets launch faster, while custom pets take a few moments to generate."]
8: ["Browse Companion Pets", "Explore different pet personalities and choose your ideal companion."]
9: ["Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets", "Signing in ensures your pet data, customization, and progress remain safe across devices.", "Sign In to Protect Progress"]
